description.value: Blue Mountain Lodge is a self-catering vacation property on the shores of Christina Lake, offering lodge suites, cabin rentals, cottages, and full-service RV sites on 1.5 acres less than two minutes' walk from the lake. All units are self-contained with kitchenettes, BBQs, and linens included, and the property sits within easy reach of the area's hiking and biking trails. The lodge is pet-friendly and operates a seasonal rental model from the May long weekend through Labour Day.
